focus: Recover the fork SessionStart payload shape from repo contracts and the fork's own recorded hook output, then check whether sibling SessionStart hooks share the gate
answeredQuestions: What does the SessionStart compact payload actually contain for a fork versus its parent session?

findings.label: The repo's own contract documents the Claude SessionStart payload as source (startup/compact/resume/clear), session_id, transcript_path, stop_hook_active and context_window_tokens — there is no agent id, subagent flag or fork marker any hook could read.

The contract states compact-pointer's intent as running on SessionStart "after a compaction", but the implementation trusts `source === 'compact'` as proof that a compaction happened, so the contract's precondition is unenforced in code.

A second, independent SessionStart hook in the same fork logged `SessionStart triggered (source: compact, session: 0b9dc60c-478f-4659-8191-2da52f1cd765)` to its stderr (recorded at line 195 of the fork transcript agent-ae7668a35ed03d742.jsonl), independently confirming that a fork's payload carries source=compact and the parent's session id.

`session-prime`'s compact branch shares the hazard: it keys the cached compact brief by session_id and injects it whenever source=compact, so the same fork received the parent's post-compaction brief (cached at 2026-10-21T15:29:16.367Z) one minute before it read the parent's note.

Session-scoped hook state is broadly keyed by session_id rather than by agent: the spec-gate state directory holds one file per hex-encoded session id, and one of them (30623964633630632d...) decodes to 0b9dc60c-478f-4659-8191-2da52f1cd765, so a fork writing gate state writes the parent's record.

ruledOut.direction: Read a fork marker out of the SessionStart payload
ruledOut.reason: The documented payload contract exposes no agent id, subagent flag or fork marker; a fix must derive fork-ness from a value the payload does carry.

ruledOut.direction: Fork runs the hook in a separate state directory
ruledOut.reason: stateDir() keys on uid (501), not on agent, so forks and parent share one relaunch state directory.
